transcript: Three high-fiber foods that heal the body from within. My friend, many people come to me and say, Master Yang, I eat healthy, but I still feel heavy, tired or bloated. And when I ask what they eat, most of them are missing one simple thing, fiber. Fiber is like the quiet broom of the body. It sweeps the waist, balances the sugar and calms the fire of inflammation. It can even help reverse insulin resistance and melt the stubborn fat around your belly. Number one, avocado, a sacred fruit of balance. It feeds your cells with good fats, potassium and magnesium. When you eat avocado, you nourish the heart, the brain and the skin all at once. Number two, berries, blueberries, raspberries, strawberries, small fruits with great wisdom. They protect your heart, clear your blood and awaken your memory. Number three, chia seeds. Do not be fooled by their size. When soaked, they expand just like your energy will. They are full of omega-3 and calm inflammation from deep within. Try them in coconut milk. Let them rest overnight and become your morning medicine. Each of these foods is a gift from nature. And when you combine them, your digestion becomes light, your mind becomes clear and your energy flows freely again. If you wish to go deeper, my full wisdom ebook is on my profile. It's a small paid guide for those truly ready to heal.
